page-organizations-small-business-settle: A stablecoin payment to your own Ethereum account works like cash in hand. Once payment arrives, it's yours.

Card payments can be clawed back through a chargeback long after the sale. Once a stablecoin payment is confirmed, nobody can reverse it. This occurs within seconds on layer 2 networks and a few minutes on Ethereum Mainnet.

Ethereum network fees are charged per transaction, not as a percentage of the amount. Sending a whole day's sales to a secure vault account costs the same as a small payment, from a fraction of a cent to a few cents.
No card processor takes a cut. You can charge customers less than you would for a card payment and still take home more.

Payments go to an account whose keys never need to be kept at the store. <link>Smart accounts</link> can set spending limits and require more than one approval, so staff can issue a refund without being able to move the whole balance.
Nothing in the cash register to steal
Get paid like cash, without the cash drawer
